snippet.title: PROP SUMO | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Prop Sumo is a physics-driven fighting game that pits ordinary props together in extraordinary battles!

OUTPLAY YOUR FRIENDS
Your goal in Prop Sumo is to be the last prop standing. Brawl your opponents with a variety of melee moves, or just launch yourself into them with a powerful charge!

Unleash a chain of combo attacks and send your friends flying in every direction!

Sign Up! 
For the latest Playtest at Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/
